title: Labels
lead: Labels organize your articles. They never mean “like” or “dislike”: adding a label does not turn on classification or teach Bantoozi what you prefer.
leadExamples: Examples on a label only teach what the label means, and only for articles you have already chosen to analyze.
emptyBody: Create a label to sort articles into groups of your own.
deleteBody_one: “{{name}}” will be removed from {{count}} article. The article stays in your reader.
deleteBody_other: “{{name}}” will be removed from {{count}} articles. The articles stay in your reader.

editor.name: Name
editor.colorHint: A six-digit hex colour, for example #64748b.
editor.examplesHint: Examples show what the label does and doesn't mean. You can remove them from the label in the list.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the label.
errors.definitionRequired: Describe what belongs under this label.
errors.definitionTooShort: Describe it in at least {{min}} characters.
errors.tooLong: Keep this to {{max}} characters or fewer.
errors.characters: This text contains characters that can't be used.
errors.colorInvalid: Use a colour like #64748b: a # and six hexadecimal digits.

conflicts.alreadyHeld: You already have a label with this name and definition. Find it in your list to change it.
conflicts.contention: This label changed while you were saving it. Try saving again.
conflicts.targetHeld: You already have a label with this name and definition. Edit that label instead.
